$comment: Acceptance test groups shared by testacc-windows.yml and testacc-lab-container.yml, consumed by .github/scripts/Invoke-AccTests.ps1. Each `run` is a `go test -run` regexp (RE2: no lookahead). Families are prefix-matched so new tests of an existing resource land in the right group automatically. The catch-all group runs every ^TestAcc test that no other group claims; its skip pattern is derived from the other groups, so it never needs manual upkeep. If it starts finding tests, give the new resource family its own group.
